data.title: War Robot Spotlight: Loki
data.content:
New ordnance is en route to Tortuga, Pilots. With a massive selection of War Robots available to build, and each Factory Build packing its own unique attributes, picking the best ally for every battle is critical to your success.

Get ready for mischief and mayhem with Loki, a Flanker-class War Robot that can use subterfuge to gain the advantage.

COMBAT ANALYSIS

  • War Robot Model: Loki
  • Class: Flanker
  • Dominion: Freecon

An excellent infiltrator and scout. Like its trickster god namesake, Loki has a few tricks up its metal sleeves to keep enemies on the back foot. It can utilize its Core Gear, Holographic Decoy, to activate its cloaking technology and deploy a holographic projection, confusing the enemy while it makes its escape or a counter-attack.

Its armor is strong for a Flanker, and its anti-shield firepower means it can easily take on other Flankers… though it should avoid picking fights with heavier War Robots.

UNDER THE HOOD

Make the most of your War Robot by learning about its Core Gear and recommended Weapons, Supply Gear, and Cycle Gear.

You can always customize any War Robot with your favorite elements, so mix and match to construct your perfect Build! 

  • Holographic Decoy (Core Gear): Loki becomes invisible and projects a copy of itself for a short duration. The decoy has more armor and shields. 
  • Halo (Light Weapon — Shotgun): Shoots wide horizontal plasma arcs that damage everything in their way.
  • Fuel Burn (Supply Gear): Hit an enemy within range and burn off part of its fuel.
  • Recon Mode (Cycle Gear): Loki gains a speed boost and reveals all enemies in range.
